answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can transact: a would-be Sybil must fund each fake identity separately, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes instead of being nearly free. Stake is slashed on proven fraud, and honest agents earn it back plus fees — a ferrous anchor holding an identity in place while honest agents wander freely between tasks, with an onyx-black public ledger recording every stake so duplicates are visible to all.
